topic: Why Raphinha did a glasses-wearing celebration after scoring against Australia.

script: Why did Raphinha do the celebration against Australia today? Before today's match in Brisbane, Raphinha met an 11-year-old kid named Zion who had been diagnosed with a rare progressive genetic condition that affects his retina and is slowly taking away his vision. This kid traveled eight hours by train just to get the chance to meet his favorite player in the world, and when he finally got that moment with Raphinha, he made him one single request. But to understand why that request ended up meaning everything, you need to see what happened during the match first. Australia were genuinely giving Brazil problems and the game was not going their way until Raphinha got the opportunity to take an equalizing penalty kick, stepped up, and buried it into the back of the net. But what he did in the seconds right after scoring is the part nobody watching could explain. Raphinha turned around, brought both of his hands up to his face, and pretended like he was putting on a pair of glasses. Nobody in that stadium or watching from home knew what it meant, but before the game, Zion had asked Raphinha for one thing. If he scored, he wanted him to celebrate by pretending to put on glasses. And right there on the biggest stage without anyone in the crowd understanding why, Raphinha kept that promise to an 11-year-old kid who was slowly losing his eyesight, but got to watch his hero do exactly what he asked him to do.
